jobs.name: Founding Senior Software Engineer
jobs.desc: Developed an AI-driven web scraping tool focusing on data collection, aggregation, and structuring. Designed and implemented a scalable AI solution exposed as an API interface. Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to extract critical data chunks. Designed and deployed a workflow for the internal content team using adminJS. Integrated Metabase for data visualization and created an alert management system. Set up and configured Signoz to monitor OpenTelemetry (Otel) data.

jobs.name: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.desc: Designed and implemented eNACH for the Personal Loan product, boosting loan collections by 45%. Integrated services of multiple NBFCs to enable Postpe as a Direct Selling Agent (DSA), increasing revenue by 8% per month. Contributed to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of ledger management and bill generation systems. Developed a system to make Postpe a payment option in multiple payment gateways, raising the average user bill by ₹250 per month. Contributed to the development and maintenance of Credit Card Bill Payment (CCBP) and Utility Bill Payment (UBP) services, improving test case coverage to 89%. Built and maintained the consumer token system for secure user login.
